en: The image shows a sepia-toned, vintage photograph of a rural valley flanked by gently wooded hills, with a few houses scattered amongst trees and open grassy fields. The foreground includes a tree whose branches frame the view. The bottom of the image contains a handwritten-style caption in German. The reverse side has typical postcard markings, German text, and a blue stamp indicating 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
